title: Resolve removal authority and jurisdiction policy activation
exact_question: Obtain current counsel-approved rules for subject authority, authorized-agent evidence, California DROP, source/controller exemptions, and external-write eligibility; define the exact activation and expiry criteria for each jurisdiction/channel.
safe_boundary: Unknown or stale legal/TOS classifications default to HUMAN_ONLY or DISABLED; no automated legal claim, filing, or external write is permitted.
unblock_condition: Versioned policy records with citations, effective dates, authority requirements, counsel approval, and machine-testable decisions are present.
release_impact: Blocks legal-write and removal-channel release gates; discovery and non-destructive evidence work may continue.
